name: generate_designed_pdf
description: Lay out supplied content into a beautiful PDF using HTML/CSS. The caller provides the text/data; this skill designs and renders it.

content.description: Exact material to include in the PDF (body copy, lists, tables as text, etc.). The skill must not invent or replace facts; only structure and style it.

designBrief.description: Optional: visual direction (e.g. minimalist, brand colors, resume vs report). Does not supply new factual content.

outputPath.description: Where to save the PDF under workspace/.

steps.messageTemplate: Your designed PDF has been generated successfully at {{result.outputPath}}.
